description: A real-size flag on a pole behind the subject, flying in the scene's wind: it leans out as the wind rises and ripples faster in stronger wind, and hangs in calm air. Stateless (analytic travelling wave), so nothing is baked; it never crosses the subject. Outdoor worlds only.

windCalibration.unit: flag lean: the quasi-static drag angle of engine/physics/cloth (T107) at the field speed
